title: Woman in a wet white nightgown flying at high speed over a stormy sea with…
content:
Woman in a wet white nightgown flying at high speed over a stormy sea with giant waves and a tempest; the woman powerfully strikes and cuts through the waves.

Splashing giant waves, continuous shot changes.

Fast, dynamic camera movement around the woman.

Violent, raging giant waves; woman cutting through the waves with great power, flying rapidly, completely drenched.

Lightning striking the ocean near the woman.

Low-angle shot.

Colossal, photorealistic cinematic scene.

Toma en ángulo bajo.
